title: Every write guard reads gh pr and issue comment bodies and pr review bodies as text
why: Source: branch archive/no-undo-extra-acts (commit e6053e86b), dropped from #1099 as beyond its brief (coordinator 21:16 CST Nov 9). The change makes every write guard read those bodies as text, not shell (hooks/guard_frozen.py, about line 362), so a guard passes an act main refuses today.
note: Before a lane starts, name the incident it answers (rule building-guard-needs-incident): a false alarm on a comment body is the likely one. Related: post-body-no-shell-subst (a bare substitution in a body must still be refused). Filed 21:15 CST Nov 9. Incident, round 3 of #1099 (coordinator 22:33 CST Nov 9): a cloud coordinator's `gh pr comment` with a quoted `>` in its body is refused. Ready, lane ended and not landed: no step PR (#1099 is no-undo-lane-commits, the incident PR); no commit on main (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 06:03 CST Nov 10). Doing 06:06 CST Nov 10 in lane session_013NEJL3Lf166yzVq69LsAxg (coordinator). #2499 (comment and review bodies read as text in the write guards) merged in batch 71 (#2510, main 6e8d6ccf9, 07:36 CST Nov 10; head checked on main by triage). #2537 released to batch 72 (coordinator 07:40 CST Nov 10). #2537 is out of batch 72 ( CST Nov 10, coordinator): after batch 72 merges, it must re-point the three coordinator-scope cases of #1099. Its lane waits for the coordinator.
